ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: Based on the food web, what does Hawk consume?
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: On the left side of the image is a terrestrial food chain, labeled from bottom to top in order as Plant, Grasshopper, Mouse, Snake, Hawk. The arrows point upward from lower organisms to higher organisms, with one arrow from Snake pointing to Hawk. Reasoning: In a food web, arrows usually indicate the direction of energy flow, that is, from the organism being eaten to the organism that eats it. Therefore, Snake pointing to Hawk means Hawk consumes Snake.
